description: This file is the main implementation module for a Files API in a larger machine learning or LLM-related project, containing functions for creating, retrieving, deleting, listing, and accessing contents of files, with support for multiple providers (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc.), both synchronously and asynchronously. It defines external dependencies, configuration handling, and multiple API interaction functions.
